title.en: My First Week in a New Place

subtitle: 記錄搬到新環境第一週的經歷與心情
task: Write a diary entry about your first week in a new place, such as a new school, dorm, or city. What was hard, what surprised you, and how do you feel now?
taskZh: 寫一篇日記，記錄你在新環境（例如新學校、新宿舍或新城市）的第一週：什麼事情很難？什麼讓你驚訝？你現在的心情如何？
focus: 用過去式寫這週發生的事，用現在式寫現在的心情
具體寫出遇到的困難與幫助

en: This week I moved into my new dorm in Tainan. On the first night, I could not sleep because everything felt strange. I missed my family and my own bed.

The first few days were difficult. I got lost twice on campus, and I did not know where to buy dinner. Luckily, my roommate showed me a cheap noodle shop near the back gate. We ate there together three times this week.
Now I feel much better than I did on Monday. I still miss home, but I am starting to like my new life here.
zh: 這週我搬進了台南的新宿舍。第一個晚上，我因為一切都很陌生而睡不著。我很想念家人，也想念自己的床。
前幾天很辛苦。我在校園裡迷路了兩次，也不知道晚餐要去哪裡買。幸好，室友帶我去後門附近一家便宜的麵店。這週我們一起去那裡吃了三次。
現在我覺得比星期一好多了。我還是會想家，但我開始喜歡這裡的新生活了。
